ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity dominance; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels localized along the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field covering the central 80% of both lobes; low-intensity black banding tracing the entire trailing edge and distal tips; small dark focal clusters visible in the right lobe interior adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp interior angle of approximately 35-45 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency sawtooth serrations along the entire trailing edge; peak amplitudes range from 3-12 pixels with irregular spacing; right lobe exhibits more pronounced, jagged valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to an upward sweep toward the tapered fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters on the inner right lobe, likely corresponding to focal scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark, vertically-oriented oval scar/indentation located on the right lobe approximately 20 pixels from the median notch vertex.
other_distinctive_markers: The right-most distal tip exhibits a jagged, multi-pointed serration profile that is more structurally complex than the left distal tip.
